primary_attestation.source: Tan-Zhou arXiv:2503.11934v1 Section4(2), local text mathematics/kirkman-large-sets-57-87/sources/tan-zhou-2503.11934.txt lines1111-1113; published DCC93(10)(2025)4117-4140, body not accessed.
primary_attestation.quote: Find a gcDCQS(v^4 : 0) for v = 20, 32. ... the existence of a gcDCQS(32^4: 0) will yield an mcDSQS(2^{2n+1}) for any integer n >= 4.
primary_attestation.previous_component: The v=20 component is parent-verified in review/gcdcqs20-parent-verdict.md. The v=32 component remains open in the sources checked; v=20 does not imply v=32.
primary_attestation.known_input: Lemma3.4 and Appendix B lines1321-1373: cyclic mcDSQS(32) base blocks and its derived colouring at0 are printed. Recheck this input independently; it is needed for families, not for gcDCQS existence.

exact_object.points: 128 points partitioned into four groups of32, empty stem. Use labels 32g+a, g0..3, a0..31.
exact_object.candelabra_blocks: 80384 distinct4-subsets. Every3-subset not contained in one group occurs exactly once; no3-subset within a group occurs. Allowed group multiplicities: 2+2, 2+1+1, 1+1+1+1.
exact_object.derived_at_x: For each point x, D_x={B minus{x}: x in B}, an incomplete STS(127,31) with hole G(x) minus{x}; 2512 triples. Every pair not wholly inside the hole is covered once; no hole pair is covered.
exact_object.good_colouring: At EVERY point x, partition D_x into exactly r=chi'(127)=64 nonempty partial parallel classes, among which exactly s=64-(127-31)/2=16 avoid the hole. By counting, at most16 can avoid it. No symmetry, profile, cyclic or orbit restriction is part of the target.

consequence_bridge.corollary: Tan-Zhou Corollary2.6, lines684-693: m=32 is8 mod12. With an mcDSQS(32) and Theorem2.5 inputs (2-RSQS*(4^t), t>=2; RDTD(3,4,32), gcd(32,4)=4 not2 and gcd(32,18)=2 not3), it yields mcDSQS(32*4^t) for t>=2, i.e. 2^(2n+1), n>=4.
consequence_bridge.order128: Construction2.1 with s=0 would also yield mcDSQS(128), as in the accepted order80 bridge. Check it separately; not part of gcDCQS acceptance.

Symmetric searches are optional search choices. Any restricted UNSAT/UNKNOWN never answers the unrestricted target. Record exact model sizes and a measured scaling plan before long CNF runs.
